purpose: Apply the same downstream multimodal reconciliation discipline used for rare biology to the ordinary/continuous target-discovery biology represented by C1/C2/C3/C6/C4, without allowing ATAC, SCENIC+, Morabito, spatial or perturbation evidence to retrospectively redefine the frozen RNA target.

scope.regular_biology_definition: Common, continuous, intermediate-frequency or broadly recurrent biological state/program/geometry encoded by a frozen foundation candidate; not restricted to rare tails or discrete rare neighborhoods.
scope.C5: Regulatory specialist only; cannot rescue failed foundation biology.

freeze_objects: query definition and q-safety for C3/C6/C4
relational definition for C2/C4 if active
freeze_before_multimodal_rule.prohibition: No ATAC/SCENIC+/Morabito/spatial/perturbation outcome may be used to alter the frozen RNA direction, state boundary, queried feature set, or target winner retrospectively.

gse214979_same_nucleus.role: Primary same-physical-nucleus RNA+ATAC assay for ordinary TD biology after target freeze.
gse214979_same_nucleus.unit: nucleus nested within donor; donor is biological replication unit
primary_questions: Does the frozen RNA state/program/geometry correspond to reproducible chromatin/regulatory variation in the exact same nuclei?
Does ATAC sharpen, split or falsify the frozen RNA state without redefining it?
What privileged RNA+ATAC increment exists beyond RNA-only teacher state?
Which privileged increment is donor-held-out recoverable from full/partial RNA and which remains teacher-private?
Are observed increments robust to depth, detection, library/operator, feature support and matched/random regulatory controls?
gse214979_same_nucleus.identity_rule: Primary deciding analysis excludes HCT17HEX/HCTZZT unless an independently authenticated correction predates outcome opening; sensitivity cannot rescue primary failure.

morabito_gse174367.role: Donor-level separate-nucleus recurrence/transport test after the same-nucleus assay.
morabito_gse174367.pairing: RNA and ATAC are different nuclei; never create same-cell pairs.
primary_questions: Across shared donors, does the frozen RNA program/state vary in the same direction as donor-level ATAC/regulatory support?
Does the frozen biology transport across a distinct acquisition/sample structure without requiring cell-level pairing?
Are donor-level associations robust to cell-composition, depth/support and source/operator descriptors?
morabito_gse174367.unit: donor or prospectively defined donor×broad-cell-family summary
morabito_gse174367.non_independence: Development-exposed supporting asset; not pristine target-selection benchmark.

scenic_stage75_regulatory.role: Mechanistic/regulatory interpretation layer for frozen regular biology, never an answer key.
allowed: motif/enhancer/regulon enrichment against frozen RNA states
forbidden: mandatory graph topology without new topology-specific qualification
scenic_stage75_regulatory.historical_negative_prior: Stage73R context graph did not beat target-shuffled or STRING controls; topology-specific superiority is not established.

seaad_multiome.role: Internal same-nucleus corroboration after the primary GSE214979 analysis.
seaad_multiome.boundary: SEA-AD contributed to the broader development ecosystem and is not pristine independent validation.

spatial.role: Localize frozen regular programs/states where panel coverage is sufficient.
spatial.rule: Missing program genes/features are missing evidence, not negative biology; spatial data cannot redefine the program.

perturbation.role: Late R3 directional/causal-support layer for frozen programs and regulators after target and regulatory interpretation are fixed.
perturbation.rule: In-silico perturbation or exposed perturbation assets cannot by themselves establish causality or select the foundation target.

recoverability_decomposition.RNA_RECOVERABLE: Privileged multimodal increment reproducibly predictable under donor holdout; eligible for shared teacher/student target block.
recoverability_decomposition.PREDICTABLE_BUT_STOCHASTIC: Information is partially recoverable; use distributional/uncertainty target rather than deterministic point matching.
recoverability_decomposition.TEACHER_PRIVATE: Biologically coherent privileged information is not reproducibly RNA-identifiable; retain in teacher/private interpretation and uncertainty, not student point loss.
recoverability_decomposition.NO_PRIVILEGED_INCREMENT: Frozen RNA biology stands as RNA biology; absence of ATAC increment does not retrospectively invalidate an already-qualified RNA target unless a prospectively defined falsification condition is met.

candidate_specific_questions.C1_SHARED_EMERGENT: Does the shared RNA state correspond to donor-recurrent same-nucleus chromatin/regulatory structure and transport across donors/sources?
candidate_specific_questions.C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED: If replay keeps C2 active, do frozen relational neighborhoods/geometry have same-nucleus regulatory coherence beyond ordinary state similarity and operator effects?
candidate_specific_questions.C3_QUERY_MEASURED: Does query-conditioned RNA state carry regulatory/chromatin information beyond shared state, query abundance, depth/detection and feature-support controls?
candidate_specific_questions.C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE: Does shared+query biology show multimodal increment beyond the stronger constituent C1 or C3 without adding shortcut/operator dependence?
candidate_specific_questions.C4_STRUCTURED_COMPOSITE: If C2 is active, does adding relational structure to C6 yield a real multimodal biological increment beyond C6 rather than redundant/technical geometry?

nonrescue: Multimodal PASS cannot select or rescue a foundation candidate that failed its mandatory RNA/relational/rare-program gates.
Multimodal FAIL cannot be used to retrospectively redefine the target to fit the modality.
C2/C4 cannot be rescued if corrected replay eliminates the relational component.
No pathology/clinical label may guide this reconciliation before target/representation freeze.
No single weighted cross-modality score is authorized.
non_authority_statement: Design-only. No multimodal analysis, target selection, representation selection, TD60, Stage4 or real training authority is created.
